blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.
blocks.zh: 语音合成前的翻译更新分组是否改变两位翻译之间测量的完成差距? 我们把StreamAtt 与它10次英德会谈的固定历史基线相比较。 对于每一译本,我们保持预定文本及其可用时间的固定,并改变如何组合更新以便综合。 四秒编组将StreamAtt的平均完成铅由106.6秒与XTTS-v2的比分增加至229.1秒,但与Piper的比分从169.5秒降至146.5秒. 两者都产生更短的音频;由于效果相反,播放回放闲置账户的不同变化. 这些方向在单独选定的20个对讲面板上重现。 在继续CosyVoice 3会话时,分组将组合成对的音频保留不变,并延迟了20个街区中的19个完成. 因此,语音模型比较需要具体说明文本是如何进入合成的,而不仅仅是使用哪个合成器. 识别和自动文字时间安排描述产出,但没有确定翻译的准确性或可知性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A speech translator can produce text early and still finish speaking late. Simultaneous translation is commonly evaluated by relating text-emission delay to translation quality ( Ma et al., 2019 ; Ma et al., 2020 ; Papi et al., 2022 ; Papi et al., 2023 ; Papi et al., 2024 ) . Spoken output adds synthesis and serial playback: committed text must become audio, and that audio must be played in order. Work on simultaneous speech-to-speech translation therefore also studies initial waiting, synthesized duration, and output completion ( Zheng et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Kano et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 语音翻译员可以提早生成文本,仍能完成晚语. 同时翻译通常通过将文本排放延迟与翻译质量联系起来来评价(Ma等,2019;Ma等,2020;Papi等,2022;Papi等,2023;Papi等,2024). 口语输出会增加合成和串行回放:承诺的文本必须成为音频,音频必须按顺序播放. 因此,同步语音对语音翻译的工作也研究了初始等待、综合持续时间和产出完成情况(郑等,2020;刘等,2022;卡诺等,2023)。

blocks.en: Using the same text-to-speech (TTS) model for two translators does not make their synthesis inputs comparable. One translator may emit many short updates, while another emits fewer, longer ones. The system can synthesize each update separately or group several updates first. Grouping changes both text context and request boundaries; the resulting audio can differ in duration even when the intended words do not change.
blocks.zh: 对两位翻译使用相同的文字对语音(TTS)模型并不能使其合成投入具有可比性. 一个翻译员可能会发出许多简短的更新,而另一个翻译员发出更少,更长的更新. 系统可以将每次更新分别合成,或者首先分组数个更新. 分组既会改变文本上下文,又会请求边界;因此产生的音频即使在预期的单词不变时,其持续时间也可能不同.

blocks.en: Liu et al. (2022) study the trade-off between initial waiting and synthesized duration. Related evaluation work examines sensitivity to segmentation, computation accounting, and aggregation ( Papi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Polák et al., 2026 ) . Long-form speech-output evaluation uses recognition and alignment to examine generated speech ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , while systems differ in how translated text enters synthesis ( Djanibekov et al., 2026 ) . Our question is not whether grouping can shorten one system’s playback. It is whether grouping changes the completion gap between two translators.
blocks.zh: 刘等(2022年)研究了初始等待和合成持续时间之间的取舍. 相关的评价工作审查了对分解、计算核算和汇总的敏感性(Papi等,2025;Xu等,2025;Polák等,2026)。 长式语音-输出评价使用识别和对接来检查生成的语音(薛等,2026年),而系统在翻译文本如何输入合成方面则有所不同(Djanibekov等,2026年). 我们的问题不是分组能否缩短一个系统的回放。 分组是否改变两名笔译员之间的完成差距。

blocks.en: We compare StreamAtt’s attention-based audio-history selection with its fixed-audio-history baseline, using the same translation checkpoint ( Papi et al., 2024 ) . We save each strategy’s German text updates and availability times, then replay each stream under different grouping rules. Text stays fixed across grouping conditions within a strategy, not across the two strategies. This control separates the grouping intervention from changes to the saved translation stream.
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的翻译检查站(Papi等人,2024年),将StreamAtt基于注意力的音频历史选择与其固定的音频历史基线进行比较。 我们保存每个策略的德语文本更新和可用时间,然后根据不同的分组规则重放每个流. 文本在一项战略中,而不是在两项战略中,在分组条件之间保持不变。 此控件将分组干预从被保存的翻译流中分离出.

blocks.en: Four-second grouping widens StreamAtt’s mean completion lead with XTTS-v2 but narrows it with Piper. A separate twenty-talk panel reproduces both directions. Duration and playback idle explain where the completion changes occur, but do not isolate an architectural cause. The contribution is this controlled comparison and its implication for evaluation: reporting a TTS model without its text-grouping rule leaves part of the timing comparison unspecified.
blocks.zh: 四秒编组将 StreamAtt 的平均完成铅与 XTTS-v2 相拓宽,但将其与 Piper相收缩. 单独的20个对话面板复制两个方向。 持续时间和回放闲置解释完成变化发生在何处,但不孤立建筑原因. 其贡献是这种有控制的比较及其对评价的影响:在没有文本分组规则的情况下报告一个TTS模型,留下了时间比较的一部分未说明。

blocks.en: 2 Study Design
blocks.zh: 2 研究设计

blocks.en: We separate translation from synthesis. For each talk and strategy, the saved stream contains updates ( x i , a i ) (x_{i},a_{i}) : newly committed text and its availability time. A grouping rule combines updates into synthesis input; an input-limit splitter may divide that input into several requests. Within a backend, changing the rule preserves the stream, voice, inference settings, and playback rule. Audio duration, synthesis cost, and playback timing are outcomes. Across backends, request text is shared at matched timer settings, but voice, frontend, and hardware differ.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: On the exploratory panel, four-second grouping increases StreamAtt’s mean lead from 106.58 to 229.08 seconds with XTTS, but reduces it from 169.46 to 146.46 seconds with Piper (Table 2 ). The XTTS effect is negative on nine of ten talks; the Piper effect is positive on seven (Figure 1 ). StreamAtt leads on eight XTTS talks without grouping and all ten with grouping; it leads on all ten Piper talks at both waits. The mean ordering does not reverse.

blocks.en: Grouping shortens StreamAtt’s XTTS audio by 357.00 seconds while adding 22.03 seconds of idle. Most of that saving therefore advances completion. With Piper, StreamAtt saves more audio than the baseline—73.71 versus 50.63 seconds—but adds much more idle: 60.75 versus 14.66 seconds. It finishes 12.96 seconds earlier, while the baseline finishes 35.97 seconds earlier. The baseline gains more at the endpoint, so StreamAtt’s lead narrows. This accounting explains where the seconds go, not an architectural cause. On baseline talk 805, changing XTTS grouping from two to four seconds saves 33.408 seconds of audio and adds exactly the same idle: completion is unchanged.

blocks.en: Both recognizers report lower mean total error under grouping, but more XTTS deletion mismatches. Whisper’s StreamAtt deletions rise from 612 to 1,313; its insertions fall from 1,954 to 360. These are recognition errors, not verified acoustic omissions. Detected non-speech accounts for only 38.75–43.43% of StreamAtt’s XTTS duration reduction. Without human judgments, we cannot determine how much of the shorter audio reflects fewer repetitions, faster speech, or omitted content. The baseline also produces 37.4% more intended words; this difference does not establish greater source coverage or translation accuracy.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Changing how fixed translation updates enter synthesis changes the measured completion gap between translators. The direction differs between XTTS and Piper and recurs on a separate source panel. Evaluations should report grouping and end-of-stream release rules, actual request sizes, audio duration, playback idle, and first playback alongside final completion. These timing differences should not be treated as translation-quality gains: the automatic diagnostics do not establish preserved content.
blocks.zh: 改变固定翻译更新输入合成的方式会改变笔译员之间测量的完成差距. XTTS和Piper的方向不同,在单独的源面板上重复. 评价应报告分组和流程末端发布规则,实际请求大小,音频持续时间,回放闲置,并首先在最后完成的同时回放. 这些时间差异不应被视为翻译质量的增益:自动诊断不能确定保存的内容.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The study covers English–German talks, two audio-history strategies from one checkpoint, and one voice per backend. The twenty-talk confirmation does not establish generalization across languages, domains, or voices. XTTS and Piper differ in frontend, implementation, hardware, and voice, preventing architecture-only attribution. Buffered-policy comparisons were selected after inspecting aggregate means; their exploratory intervals do not establish equivalence.
blocks.zh: 研究内容包括英语–德语对话,一个检查站的两个音频历史策略,以及每个后端一个声音. 20对口确认没有建立跨语言,域,或声音的通称. XTTS和Piper在前端,执行,硬件,和语音方面有不同,防止了架构唯一的归属. 在检查综合手段之后选择了缓冲政策比较;其探索间隔并不确定等同性。

blocks.en: Intended text is fixed within each stream, not across translators, while grouping changes both context and request boundaries. Production replay excludes feedback and device contention. Edge-silence replay holds readiness fixed, and CosyVoice uses restarted short blocks rather than continuous talks.
blocks.zh: 意向文本固定在每个流内部,而不是跨翻译,同时分组既改变上下文又要求边界. 制作回放排除了反馈和装置的争议. Edge-silence回放保持了固定的准备状态,而CosyVoice使用重启的短块来代替连续的会谈.

blocks.en: Without human listening or bilingual adequacy judgments, recognition and alignment remain indirect diagnostics. XTTS timing excludes 7.52% of alignment units; its validity rule was revised after a timestamp failure without human calibration. The unverified common-word subset covers roughly half of intended words. Source-reference quality and semantic delay remain unreported due to unverified reference coverage and acoustic offsets. For example, talk 805 has annotations ending at 386.66 seconds, but audio continues to 594.55 seconds; the remainder is not assumed silent.
blocks.zh: 没有人的倾听或双语的充分判断,承认和配合仍然是间接的诊断。 XTTS时间排除了7.52%的对齐单位;其有效性规则在一次没有人校正的时间戳故障后被修改. 未经验证的通名词子集涵盖约一半的意名词. 由于未核实的参考资料覆盖面和声学相抵,来源参考质量和语义延迟仍未报告。 例如: 第805话有以386.66秒结束的注释,但音频持续到594.55秒;其余部分不假定沉默.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Earlier completion does not necessarily imply accurate or complete translation. Our experiments use existing research recordings and publicly released synthesis voices. No new participant recordings or human evaluations were collected. All datasets, models, and voices remain subject to their respective usage conditions.
blocks.zh: 提前完成并不一定意味着准确或完整的翻译。 我们的实验使用现有的研究录音和公开发布的合成声音. 没有收集新的与会者录音或人类评价。 所有数据集,模型,语音都仍然受制于各自的使用条件.

blocks.en: The authors used generative AI tools only for code debugging and minor language editing and to improve readability. These tools were not used to generate any scientific content, experimental results, data analyses, or conclusions.
blocks.zh: 作者只使用基因AI工具来进行代码调试和次要语言编辑并改进可读性. 这些工具没有用于产生任何科学内容、实验结果、数据分析或结论。

blocks.en: C.1 Practical grouping rules

blocks.en: All rules act on the same saved streams and preserve the text sequence. The two- and four-second timers start with the oldest pending update. The punctuation rule sends a group once it contains at least three whitespace words and ends in a period, question mark, or exclamation mark (optionally followed by a closing quote or bracket), or after two seconds. The word-count rule sends a group after eight accumulated whitespace words or two seconds. Updates available at the trigger join the group; later arrivals do not reset its timer. Translation end releases any remaining text. Input-limit splitting follows grouping and preserves the joined string.

blocks.en: C.2 Direct buffered-policy comparisons
blocks.zh: C.2 直接缓冲政策比较

blocks.en: The direct comparison uses the punctuation rule and a timer with the same two-second cap. Group membership, input-limit splitting, and dispatch times are reconstructed from the saved streams. A punctuation trigger accounts for 3.39% of StreamAtt groups and 2.38% of baseline groups; end-of-translation release accounts for 0.52% and 0.63%. The remaining groups reach the timer.
blocks.zh: 直接比较采用平分规则和同分两秒盖的计时器. 小组成员、输入限制分拆和发送时间从所保存的溪流中重建。 分解触发器占StreamAtt组的3.39%和基线组的2.38%;翻译后释放量占0.52%和0.63%。 其余各组到达计时器.

blocks.en: We resample paired talks, retaining both histories and both policies in each draw. These direct contrasts were selected after inspecting the aggregate policy means, so the analysis is exploratory.
blocks.zh: 我们重新进行组合式会谈,在每次会谈中保留历史和两项政策。 这些直接对比是在检查总体政策手段后选定的,因此分析是探索性的。

blocks.en: Table 9: Punctuation-minus-two-second-timer completion-gap contrasts. Point estimates follow from the policy means in Table 8 . Intervals and direction counts use paired source contrasts.
blocks.zh: 表9:平分-减分-分-分-分-分秒完成-分-对比. 从表8的政策中得出了点估计数。 间距和方向计数使用配对源对比.

blocks.en: The XTTS paired interval is [ − 0.83 , 18.97 ] [-0.83,18.97] seconds, with a positive difference on 6/10 talks; the Piper interval is [ − 3.18 , − 0.72 ] [-3.18,-0.72] , with 2/10 positive talks. Most groups reach the common timer cap, so this contrast compares two similar dispatch rules. It does not establish that all reasonable buffered policies are interchangeable.
blocks.zh: XTTS配对间隔为 [−0.83, 18.97] [-0.83, 18.97] 秒,对6/10的会谈有正差; Piper间隔为 [− 3.18, − 0.72] [-3.18,-0.72], 有2/10正差. 大多数组达到常见的计时器上限,因此这种对比比较了两个相类似的调度规则. 它没有确定所有合理的缓冲政策是可以互换的。

blocks.en: C.3 XTTS synthesis seeds
blocks.zh: C.3 XTTS 合成种子

blocks.en: The full-talk comparison uses seeds 5242, 5243, and 5244 on the ten exploratory talks, both histories, and immediate/four-second grouping. The original seed-5242 outputs are retained; all non-seed settings remain fixed. The three seed-level mean effects are negative, ranging from − 127.6 -127.6 to − 116.8 -116.8 seconds. The original effect is − 122.50 -122.50 seconds. The seed is reset before each synthesis request; seed-level records are retained in the numerical supplement. This checks the sign and scale of the observed XTTS interaction, not every possible synthesis realization.
blocks.zh: 全面比较使用种子5242,5243和5244进行十次探索性会谈,既有历史,也有即时/四秒分组. 原种-5242产出保留;所有非种子设置保持不变. 三种种子水平的平均效果为负,从−127.6-127.6到−116.8-116.8秒. 原始效果为-122.50-122.50秒. 种子在每次综合请求前被重置;种子级别记录保留在数字补充中. 这个检查所观察到的XTTS交互的标志和规模,而不是每一种可能的合成实现.

blocks.en: C.4 Piper realization variability
blocks.zh: C.4 管道实现可变性

blocks.en: The comparison combines forty archived Piper outputs with eighty newly synthesized outputs: the ten exploratory talks, both histories, and immediate/four-second grouping in each of three realizations. Voice, inference settings, and CPU model are unchanged. The two new runs use counterbalanced condition orders; the original run is retained as a historical realization rather than treated as counterbalanced. Realization identifiers do not imply controlled or independent random seeds. All completed outcomes are retained.
blocks.zh: 比较结合了40个已存档的Piper产出和80个新综合产出:10个探索性会谈,既包括历史,又包括三个实现中的每一个即时/四秒分组。 语音,推论设置,CPU模型不变. 两个新运行使用逆平衡条件令;原运行作为历史实现保留,而不是作为逆平衡处理. 实现标识符并不意味着控制或独立随机种子. 所有完成的成果均予保留。

blocks.en: The mean interaction is + 23.01 +23.01 seconds in the original run and + 23.71 +23.71 and + 23.99 +23.99 seconds in the two new runs. The respective numbers of talks with positive interactions are 7/10, 8/10, and 9/10. The two new runs have 95% paired-talk bootstrap intervals of [ 7.97 , 41.65 ] [7.97,41.65] and [ 8.86 , 40.94 ] [8.86,40.94] seconds. The average narrowing direction therefore recurs in both repetitions.

For each talk, we compute the sample standard deviation of its interaction across the three realizations. The median of these standard deviations is 0.96 seconds and the maximum is 6.37 seconds. Talk 1381 has the largest range, from + 7.89 +7.89 to + 20.16 +20.16 seconds. Some near-zero source effects change sign across runs. These repetitions describe variability on the same ten talks; they are not additional independent sources or evidence of equivalence between realizations.
blocks.zh: 对于每个谈话,我们计算其跨越三个实现的相互作用的样本标准偏差. 这些标准偏差的中位数为0.96秒,最大为6.37秒. Talk1381的射程最大,从+7.89+7.89到+20.16+20.16秒. 一些近零源效应变化标志横行. 这些重复描述的是同一十个会谈的可变性;它们不是实现之间等同性的额外独立来源或证据.

blocks.en: C.5 Request-edge silence
blocks.zh: C.5 请求方沉默

blocks.en: The edge-silence replay keeps each request’s measured readiness and changes only its sample duration. Silero probabilities ( Silero Team, 2024 ) are evaluated at thresholds 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7. Leading and trailing material outside a 100-ms speech guard is removed; interior pauses and request order are unchanged. Playback is recomputed from the modified durations.
blocks.zh: 边缘静静回放会保持每个请求的量度准备状态,只改变其样本持续时间. Silero概率(Silero Team,2024年)按0.3,0.5和0.7的阈值进行评估. 将100米外的导出和跟踪材料取出;内部暂停和请求顺序不变. 回放从修改后的持续时间重算出.

blocks.en: Across thresholds, the interaction ranges from − 96.37 -96.37 to − 87.58 -87.58 seconds for XTTS and from + 16.94 +16.94 to + 19.72 +19.72 seconds for Piper (Table 10 ). At threshold 0.5, the effects are − 91.76 -91.76 and + 18.43 +18.43 seconds, respectively. Removing the detected request edges reduces the magnitude but preserves the negative XTTS and positive Piper directions. Because readiness is held fixed, this is a retrospective sensitivity analysis, not a timed online trimming implementation or a content-preservation test.
blocks.zh: 跨越阈值,XTTS的相互作用从−96.37-96.37到−87.58-87.58秒;Piper的相互作用从+16.94+16.94到+19.72+19.72秒(表10)。 在0.5阈值下,效果分别为-91.76-91.76和+18.43+18.43秒. 删除被检测到的请求边缘会减小体积,但保留了负XTTS和正Piper方向. 因为准备状态是固定的,所以这是一个回顾性敏感性分析,而不是一个定时的在线修饰执行或内容保存测试.

blocks.en: Table 10: Mean grouping effects after request-edge silence removal, in seconds. The primary analysis uses untrimmed audio.
blocks.zh: 表10:请求端消声后的平均分组效应,以秒计。 主分析使用未接通的音频.

blocks.en: C.6 Piper readiness checks
blocks.zh: C.6 管道准备状态检查

blocks.en: In the original panel, Piper grouping shortens all twenty waveforms, but advances completion on only eight StreamAtt and seven baseline talks. The mean interaction is + 23.01 +23.01 seconds, median + 7.04 +7.04 , and range [ − 0.75 , 65.12 ] [-0.75,65.12] . The duration and idle components are − 23.08 -23.08 and + 46.09 +46.09 seconds.
blocks.zh: 在最初的面板中,Piper分组缩短了所有20个波形,但只提前完成8个StreamAtt和7个基线会谈. 平均相互作用为+23.01+23.01秒,中位数+7.04+7.04,范围为[−0.75,65.12] [-0.75,65.12]. 持续时间和闲置部分为−23.08-23.08和+46.09+46.09秒.

blocks.en: A sentence-release replay makes each internal sentence available at its recorded readiness, instead of waiting for the whole request. A zero-service replay removes downstream computation time. Both retain the same waveform samples, request grouping, and original text times. Their interactions are + 23.22 +23.22 and + 23.50 +23.50 seconds, respectively. Neither completed-request buffering nor measured CPU service alone explains the positive sign. Sentence-level audio release is not a different rule for grouping text before synthesis.
blocks.zh: 一个句子放出回放让每个内部句子按其记录的准备状态提供,而不是等待整个请求. 零服务回放会去掉下游的计算时间. 两者都保留了相同的波形样本,请求分组,以及原始文本时间. 它们的相互作用分别为+23.22+23.22和+23.50+23.50秒. 既未完成请求缓冲,也未单独测量出CPU服务来解释正号. 句子级音频发布并不是在合成前分组文本的另一种规则.

blocks.en: The source-paired difference between Piper’s and XTTS’s four-second interactions is + 145.51 +145.51 seconds, with interval [ 90.83,198.50 ] [90.83,198.50] . Nine sources are positive; talk 1381 is the exception. This comparison includes voice, frontend, implementation, and device differences.
blocks.zh: Piper和XTTS的四秒相互作用的源发相为+145.51+145.51秒,间隔为[90.83,198.50] [90.83,198.50]. 9个来源为正;谈话1381是例外. 这种比较包括语音,前端,执行,以及设备的差异.

blocks.en: C.7 Duration savings and the final endpoint
blocks.zh: C.7 持续节约和最后终点

blocks.en: Appendix D Request Structure and Content Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录D 请求结构和内容诊断

blocks.en: D.1 Updates and requests
blocks.zh: D.1 最新情况和要求

blocks.en: Whitespace-word counts include standalone punctuation and music symbols. An update is not necessarily one synthesis request: input-limit splitting can create several requests. Table 11 describes the text streams; Table 12 counts actual XTTS request occurrences after splitting. Reused requests are counted and timed each time their audio enters a replay. A text-assembly check recovers the stored canonical text in all sixty streams across the exploratory and confirmation panels. Packet-to-update agreement is also verified for all forty confirmation streams; the corresponding check is unavailable for the twenty exploratory streams. These checks concern stream assembly, not translation adequacy, and do not explain the baseline’s greater intended-text length.
blocks.zh: 白空话的计数包括独立的标点和音乐符号. 更新并不一定是一个综合请求:输入限制分拆可以产生几个请求. 表11说明了文本流; 表12列出了XTTS在拆分后请求的实际出错。 重复使用的请求在每次音频输入重播时都会被计数并计时. 文本组装检查在探索和确认面板上的所有60个流流中恢复了所储存的条形文字。 所有40个确认流的包式更新协议也得到核实;20个探索流没有相应的检查. 这些检查涉及流组装,而不是翻译的充分性,也没有解释基准的预期文本长度较大。

blocks.en: Table 11: Text-update lengths and punctuation, pooled over ten talks per system. An update can be split into several synthesis requests. Terminal punctuation does not label a prosodic boundary.
blocks.zh: 表11:更新文本的长度和标注,每个系统集合10个会谈。 一个更新可以被分为几个综合请求. 终端标出不标出正边界 。

blocks.en: Table 12: Actual XTTS request occurrences across ten recordings. Reused requests count once per use; these are not counts of unique model invocations. Input-limit splitting can create more than one request per update.
blocks.zh: 表12:实际XTTS要求10个录音出现。 重复使用的请求每一次使用一次;这些不是唯一引用模型的数。 输入限制分拆每次更新可以产生多个请求.

blocks.en: Four-second grouping removes 2,919 StreamAtt requests and 1,968 baseline requests. Total waveform savings divided by removed requests are 1.223 and 1.216 seconds, respectively; the zero-to-two-second ratios are 1.133 and 1.149. These are descriptive ratios, not a fixed cost per boundary: context, punctuation, request length, and restarts change together.
blocks.zh: 四秒分组删除了2,919个StreamAtt请求和1,968个基线请求. 按被去除的请求划分的波形节省总分分别为1.223秒和1.216秒;零相比为1.133秒和1.149秒. 这些是描述性比率,而不是每个边界的固定费用:上下文、标出、请求长度和重新开始一起变化。

blocks.en: D.2 Recognition and scoring
blocks.zh: D.2 表彰和评分

blocks.en: Whisper receives 16-kHz audio, a German transcription prefix, and no intended text. Four prefix positions leave up to 444 new decoder positions. Capacity-limited fifteen-second windows are split into 7.5-second halves and, when needed, 3.75-second quarters. Transcripts are not selected by reference score or completed from intended text.
blocks.zh: 耳语收到 16克Hz音频,一个德文的抄写前缀,没有打算的文本. 4个前缀职位留下了多达444个新的解码职位. 能力有限的15秒窗口分为7.5秒半,必要时分为3.75秒半。 译名不通过参考分数选择,也不从预定文本中完成.

blocks.en: The Table 1 word metric lowercases whitespace tokens but retains punctuation. The normalized breakdown lowercases each token, retains Unicode letters/numbers and ASCII apostrophes, and discards tokens that become empty. Counts are pooled for the error breakdown, whereas mean rates give talks equal weight. Neither statistic measures adequacy against the English source.
blocks.zh: 表 1 单词小写白空格符号,但保留平分符号。 规范的分解小写每个令牌,保留Unicode字母/数字和ASCII apostrops,并丢弃变成空的令牌. 计算错误的分解是集合的,而平均比率给予会谈同等的分量。 统计数据都无法衡量英文来源的充分性。

blocks.en: Normalized Whisper mean word edit rates decrease from 23.05% to 14.87% for StreamAtt–XTTS and from 22.38% to 17.73% for baseline–XTTS. Piper’s rates decrease from 7.65% to 6.60% and from 9.92% to 9.23%. However, XTTS deletions increase on nine StreamAtt talks and six baseline talks. Normalized total error worsens on StreamAtt talk 1102 and baseline talk 2007. Table 13 retains these adverse error components; a deletion mismatch is not a verified omitted word.
blocks.zh: 普通Whisper平均字编辑率从23.05%降至14.87% StreamAtt-TTS,基线TTS从22.38%降至17.73%. Piper的税率从7.65%下降到6.60%,从9.92%下降到9.23%. 然而,XTTS的删除增加了九次StreamAtt会谈和六次基线会谈. 在StreamAtt谈话1102和2007年基线谈话中,正常化的总错误恶化了。 表13保留了这些负面错误组件;删除不匹配不是一个经过验证的省略词.

blocks.en: Table 13: Pooled punctuation-normalized edits across all ten recordings, immediate → \to four-second grouping. Intended words are fixed within a history across waits and backends. Counts are pooled for the error breakdown; mean percentages elsewhere weight recordings equally. A deletion is an ASR mismatch, not a confirmed acoustic omission.
blocks.zh: 表13: 所有10个录音的集合平分规范化编辑,即时 \\=至四秒分组。 意向字被固定在一个历史中跨越等和后端. 错误分类的计数汇总;其他地点的平均加权记录百分比相等。 删除是ASR的错配,而不是确认的声学遗漏.

blocks.en: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B ( Shi et al., 2026 ) independently transcribes the exploratory immediate/four-second outputs without the intended text. Audio preparation, German language specification, tokenization, and scoring normalization are fixed across conditions. Table 14 reports mean word edit rates and pooled deletion counts. Like Whisper, Qwen reports lower mean total error in all four backend–history comparisons but higher XTTS deletion counts. Agreement between recognizers reduces dependence on one recognizer; it does not establish what listeners hear.
blocks.zh: Qune3-ASR-0.6B(Shi等,2026年)独立地将探索性即时产出/四秒产出录入其中,没有预定文本。 音频准备、德文规格、标语化和分数正常化是按不同条件确定的。 表14报告是指文字编辑率和集合删除数。 像华声, Quen报告在所有四个后端-历史比较中均低于总误差,但XTTS删除数较高. 承认者之间的协议减少了对一个承认者的依赖;它没有确定听众听到什么.

blocks.en: Table 14: Full-output Qwen recognition, immediate → \to four-second grouping. Rates weight talks equally; deletion counts are pooled. These are recognition mismatches, not verified acoustic omissions.

An earlier input-selected XTTS sample contains forty immediate/grouped pairs, with 15–45 lexical words per block and matching complete request spans. Selection seed 20261007 gives eighty clip IDs covering seventy-three distinct stored waveforms, including seven identical-audio pairs. Whisper and Qwen independently transcribe disjoint 7.5-second windows, with German specified and no intended text; all 160 clip–recognizer results complete. Both report fewer insertions in this sample, while StreamAtt deletions decrease and baseline deletions increase slightly. Table 15 gives the pooled error counts. Different selection and recognition context mean this clip result does not replace the full-output deletion increase.
blocks.zh: 更早的输入所选择的XTTS样本包含有40个即时/分组的对子,每个块有15–45个词汇并匹配完整的请求跨度. 选取种子20261007给出了80个剪接ID,覆盖了73个不同的被存储的波形,包括7个同型-同型对. Whisper and Quen独立地转录了断开连接的7.5秒窗口,指定了德语,没有预定的文本;全部160个剪辑-识别结果完成. 两份报告都减少了本样本中的插入,而StreamAtt的删除则会减少,而基线删除则略有增加. 表15列出集合误差数。 不同的选择和识别上下文意味着这个剪接结果不会取代全部输出删除的增加.

blocks.en: Table 15: Selected-clip edit counts, immediate → \to four-second grouping. Each row pools twenty clips per wait from ten recordings. Recognition context, windowing, and selected text coverage differ from the full-recording diagnostic; these counts do not replace its deletion increase.
blocks.zh: 表15: 选取- clip 编辑计数, 立即 \\\ 至 四秒分组 。 每行集合20个片段 从10个录音。 识别上下文,窗口化,以及所选文本覆盖度与全记录诊断不同;这些计数并不能取代删除增加.

blocks.en: D.3 Speech activity and word duration
blocks.zh: D.3 发言活动和发言时间

blocks.en: Silero speech probabilities ( Silero Team, 2024 ) are calculated on consecutive 512-sample frames at 16 kHz, resetting state between waveforms. Thresholds 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7 use the same probabilities without padding or gap merging and retain the actual final-frame duration. The complete analysis includes immediate/four-second StreamAtt–XTTS outputs for all ten talks; other coverage is partial and is not imputed.
blocks.zh: Silero语音概率(Silero Team,2024)在连续512个样本框架上以16千赫计算出,波形之间重置状态. 阈值为0.3、0.5和0.7,使用相同的概率,而不加垫或间隙合并并保留实际最终期限。 完整的分析包括所有10个会谈的即时/四秒StreamAtt-TTS产出;其他报道为部分报道,不计算在内。

blocks.en: Table 16: Mean waveform reduction under four-second XTTS grouping for StreamAtt, partitioned by speech activity. Times are seconds; all ten immediate/grouped pairs are included. The final column divides summed non-speech reduction by summed total reduction, not a mean of per-talk percentages. Detector-classified speech does not establish preserved linguistic content.
blocks.zh: 表16: StreamAtt四秒XTTS分组下按语音活性划分的平均波形减少. 时为秒;包含全部10个即时/组对. 最后一栏除以总和减少,而不是每口话百分比的平均值,将非话语减少相加。 探测器分类的语音不能确定保存的语言内容.

blocks.en: Detected non-speech explains 38.75–43.43% of the waveform reduction. Detector-classified speech does not establish preserved linguistic content. Repetition, omission, speaking rate, and detector or recognition error may contribute to the remaining reduction.
blocks.zh: 被检测出的非口音解释出波形还原的38.75–43.43%. 探测器分类的语音不能确定保存的语言内容. 重复、省略、发言率和探测器或识别出错可能有助于剩余减少。

blocks.en: A separate word-duration analysis uses unambiguous matches to identical intended occurrences, excluding invalid, ambiguous, and request/window-crossing intervals. Duration is compact-audio end minus start, not playback delay.
